entries.name: 결재 컨베이어
entries.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished actual casual mobile puzzle GAME screen, portrait 2:3, at high resolution. The two input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY, not edit targets: reference1 board-dominant colorful connecting lines and tactile round game controls; reference2 confident arrows, graphic spatial puzzle simplicity, large board and extreme low text. The Korean user rejected productivity-app mockups. This must look like a fun finished puzzle game screenshot, not a productivity app, wireframe, report, spreadsheet, tutorial infographic, or phone photograph. Single straight-on full game screen, no handset or hands outside screen, no multiple panels. Consistent new family visual language: midnight teal game shell, a subtly raised large round-corner puzzle board occupying 70% of useful screen, bright saturated tactile pieces, restrained bloom on active paths, clean strong silhouettes, gentle 2.5D depth with accurate top-down puzzle geometry, soft shadows. Top has back arrow, compact Korean game title, small stage badge "01", settings icon. Under title one brief Korean instruction. Bottom only three widely spaced game controls: curved arrow "되돌리기", reset arrow "다시하기", big bulb "힌트". Hint is free; no pricing or lives, no hearts, no store, no coins, no stars as rating. Selection uses a vivid rim, and one small in-screen white cartoon pointer indicates the first action. Render Korean text clearly and sparingly, normal crisp rounded UI font. Avoid laptop windows, SaaS filters, menus, app sidebars, form fields, columns of explanatory text, desktop chrome. This is an image-only concept; don't draw development-stage annotations.
Puzzle: "결재 컨베이어". Instruction: "도장을 찍고 알맞은 함으로 보내세요".
A real spatial path-building puzzle, not an abstract workflow chart. Board is a large 7-by-5 recessed square grid. Left entry port is a stack of tiny white documents; route reaches a Y junction in the middle. Approved-document path travels right in vivid cyan through a physical rubber stamp station then to a round tray marked "접수". Rejected-document path turns down then right in amber to a separate tray marked "보완". Little document tokens with check or ! marks travel along chunky luminous arrow tracks. Track pieces snap to grid and have strongly visible direction arrowheads. Stamp station is a tiny top-down friendly game prop with a raised red stamp handle. Leave a few obvious empty cells to build into. A short tray of ONLY FOUR chunky track pieces sits below the board: straight, corner, junction, stamp; the corner is selected and indicated by a small glove cursor. Make the puzzle board the star, tactile and colorful, like a premium path-connection mobile game. Restrained Korean text, no testing logs or sheets.
